title: 🌐 India Assumes BRICS Presidency for 2026 — 18th Summit (4 Pillars & 20-Year Milestone)
summary: RBI proposed linking official CBDCs across BRICS nations for cross-border trade and tourism payments, recommending it for the agenda of the 18th BRICS Summit 2026.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI proposed linking official CBDCs across BRICS nations for cross-border trade and tourism payments, recommending it for the agenda of the 18th BRICS Summit 2026.

items: **RBI Floats BRICS Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) Interlinkage for 2026 Summit** (Page 31): RBI proposed linking official CBDCs across BRICS nations for cross-border trade and tourism payments, recommending it for the agenda of the 18th BRICS Summit 2026.

**India Assumes BRICS Presidency for 2026 and Will Host 18th BRICS Summit** (Page 95): Brazil handed over BRICS presidency to India for 2026 (theme: Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability as BRICS marks 20 years).

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Emerging Economy Multilateral Governance. India takes over BRICS Chairship for 2026 across 4 pillars: Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability.
